subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver` in `openclaw.json`?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as the highest-precedence override.

options.title: Keep Delivery Launch-Only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and close or retitle this request to document that product choice.

options.title: Use TUI Preference Instead
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow for the delivery default.

recommendation.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as the highest-precedence override.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a config/default policy choice, and recent TUI lifecycle ownership points there for follow-up routing.
